transactional_assignment_verification.service_method: queue.matchTick({ mode, matcherId, limit, now, makeId }) in packages/services/queue.js

durable_atomicity.transaction_boundary: core.run({ actor: 'matchmaker', scope: 'matchmaker' }, 'pair:' + matchId, { type: 'queue', id: matchId, a, b, mode, turnSeconds })
durable_atomicity.lock_order: Operation identity mutex -> aggregate identity -> actor occupancy and eligibility in global sorted order -> wallets
durable_atomicity.committed_facts: Match row with OFFERED status, match.participants seated, idempotency outcome in economy.command_outcomes, and ops.outbox event committed in the same PostgreSQL transaction

racing_matchers_concurrency.result: Two matchers racing the same actors create AT MOST ONE compatible assignment and AT MOST ONE financial effect
racing_matchers_concurrency.mutual_exclusion: Claim locks in Redis serialize candidate claiming; PostgreSQL row locks on aggregate and actors serialize concurrent commits
racing_matchers_concurrency.loser_outcome: Loser encounters ALREADY_IN_MATCH or IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, rolls back completely, and leaves zero phantom match or outbox rows

occupancy_collision_and_rollback.result: An actor occupied in PostgreSQL fails with ALREADY_IN_MATCH; transaction rolls back completely
occupancy_collision_and_rollback.durable_integrity: Zero match.matches or match.participants rows created for the failed pair; zero ops.outbox events created
occupancy_collision_and_rollback.queue_remediation: Occupied actor dropped from queue (requeue: false); innocent partner requeued with original joinedAt score (requeue: true)

ranked_fee_requirement.result: Ranked queue requires both players have sufficient coins (>= quote fee) before pairing
ranked_fee_requirement.enforcement: Under-funded players skipped during ranked matching; casual queue pairs freely with 0 fee

fifo_fairness.result: Older candidate (earlier joinedAt) selected over newer candidate when both are compatible; seat 0 assigned to older entrant
fifo_fairness.unpaired_release: Unpaired candidates released with requeue: true, preserving original FIFO joinedAt score
